A '''GNK power droid''' was part of the crew on board the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Renown/Legends|Renown]]'' when it was [[Capture of the Renown|hijacked]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] forces. While this [[Power droid/Legends|power droid]] survived the hijacking with a number of other [[Droid/Legends|droids]], all living personnel on board were killed or captured. When [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] arrived on the ''Renown'', they ran into [[BNI-393/Legends|BNI-393]] who brought them back to their [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] where the surviving droids, including this [[GNK power droid/Legends|GNK]], were hiding. The group later followed a [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|buzz droid]] through the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. This droid toppled, whilst the buzz droids attempted to dismantle the unit but failed to do so. After the buzz droids were defeated, the power droid was carried back to the shuttled by an [[Unidentified MSE-6 droid (Renown)/Legends|MSE-6 mouse droid]] and returned to the shuttle and escaped before the ''Renown'' [[Carida Incident|exploded]]. The GNK droid was repaired after [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] recovered his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].
